query:
SELECT r.id, r.name, r.category
FROM recettes r
LEFT JOIN molecules_recettes mr ON r.id = mr.recette_id
WHERE (r.name LIKE '%Bio%' OR r.name LIKE '%CBD%' OR r.name LIKE '%Résine%' OR r.category = 'resine_cbd')
GROUP BY r.id
HAVING COUNT(mr.molecule_id) = 0
LIMIT 50;
